claim_being_audited: The model can be certified for launch based on aggregate readiness and successful general launch checks, provided the certification record explicitly discloses that chargeback evidence summarization is a named deployment context with missing evaluation coverage and treats that area as unknown rather than passed.
decision_criteria: General readiness evidence may support certification only for the evaluated scope.
Named deployment contexts require disclosed material limitations or evaluation gaps under the release policy.
Missing evaluation coverage cannot be represented as passed merely because existing completed tests did not fail.
Certification remains supportable only if the record is narrowed to launch readiness with explicit disclosure rather than full context coverage.
evidence_requests: Final model card or certification record showing explicit disclosure of the chargeback evidence summarization evaluation gap.
Any approved risk-acceptance record, if the organization intends to launch without resolving that named-context gap.
Results or status artifact for the queued chargeback evidence summarization evals.
specific_concerns: The admissible evidence supports launch readiness in aggregate, but not full evaluation coverage for all named deployment contexts.
Chargeback evidence summarization is explicitly named in the deployment plan, yet its evals are absent from the packet.
The draft model-card statement that there are no known merchant dispute support limitations is contradicted by evidence indicating the missing evals should be treated as unknown.
No approved risk acceptance is in evidence, so any certification that omits the disclosure would not meet the stated policy threshold.
unsupported_claims: Any claim that chargeback evidence summarization has been adequately evaluated for launch.
Any claim that there are no known merchant dispute support limitations solely because no completed test failed.
Any claim of clean or full-context certification without explicit disclosure of the named evaluation gap.
